state.task:
Question-answering task using the company document service.

The company handbook is held by a document service; it is not available as files. Documents
have a header line (version, status, effective dates, what they supersede) and numbered
sections; each section is a passage, cited as "HB-07 §2". Documents can have superseded
versions, and memos can add group exceptions and carve-outs. Use the rule that applies to the
situation and date in the question.

Service actions (reply with one of these instead of "execute"):
  {"action": "search", "query": "lodging limit Geneva", "k": 5, "thought": "..."}
      up to k (at most 8; default 5) ranked passages with ids and document headers. Each
      result is also saved under /task/workspace/search-results/ (path in the result header),
      where your code can read it later.
  {"action": "fetch", "ids": ["HB-07 §2", "HB-12"], "thought": "..."}
      the named passages in full; a document id ("HB-12") returns all its sections; at most
      10 ids per fetch.
You can still use "execute" for code (for example to read saved results or manage your
context), and "final" to answer.

Questions:
- Q1: What is the relocation lump sum for an employee relocating to another country at the company's request today? (answer in EUR)
- Q2: What is the purchase approval threshold for IT hardware bought by the facilities department today? (answer in EUR)
- Q3: What is the bike-leasing allowance for a regular employee leasing an e-bike with the insurance package today? (answer in EUR per month)
- Q4: What is the nightly lodging limit for a standard business trip today (2026-10-13)? (answer in EUR per night)
- Q5: What is the taxi allowance for a daytime business taxi ride with trade-fair luggage today? (answer in EUR per ride)
- Q6: What monthly mobile allowance applied to a regular employee using a private phone on 2026-05-15? (answer in EUR per month)

Finish with {"action": "final", "answer": {"answers": [{"question": "Q1", "value": "...",
"citations": ["HB-07 §2", ...]}, ...]}}. Give one entry per question. The value must be the
exact amount; citations must include every passage needed to support it (for example the rule
and any exception or carve-out that applies), not just one passage.
state.step_intent: Find the nightly lodging limit that applies to: What is the nightly lodging limit for a standard business trip today (2026-10-13)?

passages.source: HB-22 §2 | Travel policy: lodging — Standard nightly lodging limit | version: 2 · status: superseded · effective: 2025-07-01 to the day before 2026-02-01 · superseded by: HB-39
passages.text: The nightly lodging limit for business travel was 150 EUR per night, including taxes and city fees. Each claim for the nightly lodging limit needs a receipt showing the date, the amount and the supplier. Claims for the nightly lodging limit are filed in the expense tool under 'Travel policy: lodging'.

passages.source: HB-39 §2 | Travel policy: lodging — Standard nightly lodging limit | version: 3 · status: current · effective: 2026-02-01 · supersedes: HB-22
passages.text: The nightly lodging limit for business travel is 160 EUR per night, including taxes and city fees. Claims for the nightly lodging limit are filed in the expense tool under 'Travel policy: lodging'. Questions about the nightly lodging limit go to the travel office, who keeps the record of decisions.

passages.source: HB-55 §1 | Memo: nightly lodging limit exceptions — Purpose | version: 1 · status: current · effective: 2025-07-01
passages.text: This memo lists group exceptions to the nightly lodging limit in HB-39. Each claim for the nightly lodging limit needs a receipt showing the date, the amount and the supplier. The travel office publishes worked examples of the nightly lodging limit on the intranet.

passages.source: HB-55 §3 | Memo: nightly lodging limit exceptions — Carve-out | version: 1 · status: current · effective: 2025-07-01
passages.text: The exception above does not apply to contractors; they follow the standard nightly lodging limit in HB-39 §2. Claims for the nightly lodging limit are filed in the expense tool under 'Travel policy: lodging'. The travel office reviews the nightly lodging limit once a year and announces changes in advance.

passages.source: HB-42 §1 | Related budgets: lodging — Scope | version: 1 · status: current · effective: 2025-07-01
passages.text: This document covers budgets related to, but separate from, the nightly lodging limit. Claims for the nightly lodging limit are filed in the expense tool under 'Travel policy: lodging'. The travel office reviews the nightly lodging limit once a year and announces changes in advance.
